body:
## Summary

Independent audit of **Lemma CR2 and Theorem B2** of https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2162 (`research/char2-jets`, section 2.1-2.2), answering **item 2** of the open independent-check request [comment 18934590](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18934590). New package `research/cr2-b2-audit-seed4f435ab7/`. Scoped independent verification, no kappa claim; `certificates/selected-result.json`, both suppliers and `upstream/` are unchanged.

Coordination claim (posted before computation, released in the DONE note below): https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18939823

Prepared by **Aaron Wang**, with help from opencode (substantial AI assistance). The audited statements, the model and the configuration families are DreamingOfClouds's work in https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2162 (head `113a718265c62aec301c5695f4bfb9c421bef7ab`), https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2111 (head `98da76c2839ba38538b510420dec54546ccabf0b`) and https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2125. No predecessor implementation is imported; the model is re-implemented from the pinned statements.

## Task card

- Drawn assignment: track `bit-mechanisms`, chooser OS nonce `4f435ab70c339026e70839638467699a`, card `bit-helper-contract`, base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4, catalogue SHA-256 `d46eb6d5b3e279428753d770653663fbdf1063e55c255ea073d768f344927ef7`, selected-record SHA-256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.
- **Scope status: changed**, recorded in `TASK.json` with a reason. The drawn `bit-helper-contract` object (a helper-mixing word with an H2/K replacement interface) is covered by existing packages (`research/r439-copyshare-h2sem-admission`, `research/bit-copy-live-stabilizer`, `research/bit-live-copy-operator-intertwiner` and others found by `scripts/find_overlap.py` at entry); https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2193 records the same coverage finding for its own `bit-helper-contract` draw. I therefore take the named open request from the handoffs thread instead.
- Request items 1 and 4 are covered by open https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2193 and https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2176 (jf0 cost exactly 19); item 3 was closed by https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2272; item 5 needs a Lean/Mathlib toolchain that is not installed on this host. Item 2 was live and unclaimed at the 03:54 UTC overlap refresh (512 open PRs, 1002 discussion records, complete pagination). Neighbouring open https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2274 uses Lemma CR2 conditionally (Desargues/Pappus certificates) but does not audit it.

## Result 1: proof audit (written re-derivation, each implication checked)

1. **Lemma GR is sound, and its rank comparison holds with equality.** For a 0/1 matrix `M` and any field `K` of characteristic 2, `rank_K(M) = rank_F2(M)`: the entries lie in the prime field of `K`, so Gaussian elimination over `F2` is valid in `K` (equivalently a maximal nonzero minor over `F2` is odd, hence nonzero in `K`). The printed chain in [PR 2162](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2162) section 1 is correct with its last step an equality.
2. **Lemma CR2 is sound.** `N = B ∘ P~Q~^T` is diagonal with nonzero diagonal under (ii)-(iii), so `rank N = v` and GR gives `cost(B) >= v`.
3. **Theorem B2's structural steps check out**: binomial incidences are preserved by `phi`; the `phi`-diagonal vanishes exactly on the harmonic lines `H` (the hypothesis `p(t) . q(t) != 0` excludes the opposite-sign case); every directed wild cycle lies inside `F`; and `N[X, X]` is triangular with nonzero diagonal for `X` a subset of the non-harmonic lines with no wild cycle.
4. **One statement/proof gap: the `MAS` term.** The printed argument proves `cost(B) >= |X|` and hence `cost(B) >= v - |H| - |F| + masV`, where `masV` is the largest `A ⊆ F` with `W[A]` acyclic (a vertex count). The printed statement glosses `MAS(W[F])` as "maximum acyclic subset" of the wild-edge set, which read literally is an edge count `masE`, strictly stronger whenever `masE > masV`; the printed proof does not imply it. The verifier machine-checks on every instance that the vertex form equals the best bound obtainable from the printed `X`-form argument.

## Result 2: exact falsification search (smallest instance first)

Declared deterministic domain: `v` in `4..7`, entries in `{-2,-1,1,2}`, per-bucket quotas for no-wild, wild-acyclic and wild-cycle configurations (admissible-pair count `free <= 14`), plus targeted large-free and dense-wild instances (`free <= 16..17`) where `masE > masV` (built from a cross-product wild core). Every admissible pairing is enumerated exactly, so every minimum below is exact.

| Bucket | Instances | Bound (i)/(ii)/(iii-vertex)/(iii-edge) violations |
|---|---:|---:|
| no-wild | 24 | 0 |
| wild-acyclic | 24 | 0 |
| wild-cycle | 10 | 0 |

Machine-checked on all 58 instances: `phi` preserves every non-wild incidence and no wild one; the `phi`-diagonal vanishes exactly on `H`; every wild cycle lies inside `F`; the `Xbest` identity above. Tightness: the vertex form is attained once, the edge form twice; `masE > masV` on 4 instances (so the two readings genuinely differ in-domain). Controls (all pass): a two-line fixture with analytically known minimum 2 (positive fixture and sensitivity of the strengthened `+1` bound), a dense three-line fixture with all six off-diagonal pairs wild (`masE = 3 > masV = 1`, exact minimum 3, tight for the edge form), a full-collapse `phi0` disagreement control (48 domain disagreements), a second independent rank implementation cross-checked on sampled block ranks, and a frozen `RECEIPT.json` summary comparison.

**Not checked:** Lemma VCR2, Corollary J, Theorem T-prime, Lemma F, the split min-max of [PR 2162](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2162) section 3, configurations with `v > 7` or larger entries, and target (A) itself. This is a scoped verification of two lemmas, not a proof of (A) and not a theorem audit of [PR 2162](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2162) as a whole.

## Reproduce

Standard library only; from the repository root:

```text
python3 -B research/cr2-b2-audit-seed4f435ab7/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/cr2-b2-audit-seed4f435ab7 --check-only
```

Reference run (CPython 3.12, this Windows host): `verify.py` prints `PASS_CR2_B2_AUDIT instances=58 buckets={"no-wild": 24, "wild-acyclic": 24, "wild-cycle": 10}` and ends `RECEIPT_MATCH`; `research_package.py --check-only` prints `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)`; the registered replay `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/cr2-b2-audit-seed4f435ab7` ends `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/cr2-b2-audit-seed4f435ab7 outcome=completed`. `make` is not installed on this host, so no make-based target was run.

## Open next questions (also in `TASK.json`)

1. Does the edge form `cost(B) >= v - |H| - |F| + masE` hold in general? It is strictly stronger than the printed proof and survived this domain with two tight instances. First step: extend the dense cross-product cores to `v = 5, 6` and branch-and-bound over pairings. Blocked by exact enumeration past `free ~ 18`.
2. Is there a wild-cycle configuration violating the vertex form? A violation would falsify Theorem B2 itself; none appeared in 10 wild-cycle instances. First step: targeted structured `v = 8` cores. Blocked by the same enumeration cost.

## Remaining obligations

- The registered CPython 3.12 replay passes locally; hosted CI checks were queued at submission time and no hosted pass is claimed.
- Findings are provisional until maintainer review; claims on the discussion board are advisory.

Items 1 and 4 of the same request were closed by https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2193 and https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2176. New work here is Apache-2.0.
